description: Live blind-spot map. Agents check this before high-risk operations and log new gaps when tasks fail in recognizable ways.

regions.label: Missing Credentials
regions.description: External API, OAuth, or secrets not available to the agent at runtime.
regions.flagBehavior: Stop. Do not guess or attempt workarounds. State which credential is missing and ask for human intervention.
examples: SSH key not present on this machine

regions.label: Cross-Machine Constraint
regions.description: Task requires a resource or account only accessible from a different machine.
regions.flagBehavior: Stop. Flag the task with must_run_from: <machine> and leave it in Inbox. Do not mark it Blocked.
examples: Email account only accessible via desktop client on another machine
GUI-only tool not available over SSH

regions.label: Scope Underspecified
regions.description: Task lacks a clear output spec, acceptance criteria, or enough context to proceed safely.
regions.flagBehavior: Ask one clarifying question before starting. Do not proceed on assumptions for irreversible actions.
examples: Vague task title with no details

regions.label: Permissions Gap
regions.description: Task requires elevated permissions the agent does not currently have.
regions.flagBehavior: State the specific permission needed. Do not attempt privilege escalation. Ask for human approval.

notes: Add new regions as your swarm encounters new failure patterns. Increase weight as a failure type recurs.
